text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san, I hear today is your 
birthday. Happy birthday to you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"The horse girl who represents the proud 
Mejiro family... As the years go by, your 
illustrious prestige will surely shine 
brighter and brighter."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...That lifeline born into this world... 
Let us see whether it heralds the dawn of 
glorious splendor."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, thank you very much. I never imagined 
I would receive birthday wishes from you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Moving forward, I hope to continue being 
someone worthy of this name.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The way you carry yourself... it is 
magnificent. There is much of noble worth 
and great reward to be learned from you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Work hard. You are no ordinary soul.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Uh... yes, it would be an honor.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well then, how about we go grab a bite to 
eat to celebrate your birthday as well? My 
treat. Right, Orfe?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. As the golden chalice belongs 
entirely to Us... We shall prepare a cup 
of kaleidoscopic colors for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you very much. I would be 
delighted to attend."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It sounds like it will be precious 
time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(...Precious as it may be... this is 
shaping up to be quite a nerve-wracking 
meal...)
